title: Epic: Embedding 3D Space — visualize posts/projects/categories in 3D on web + mobile
description:
EPIC. Give signed-in users an interactive 3D view of their embedding space: captured content (posts), Focus Areas (Projects), and the global Analysis Category taxonomy rendered as a point cloud with taxonomy/assignment/match edges, on web (Next.js /space) and mobile (Expo Space screen), from ONE shared data structure.

WHY: the auto-org epic (ao-gpx, merged on this branch, PR #2) files content silently — users can't see why something matched a Project or how their material clusters. This epic makes the embedding space visible and interactive, and fixes the silent-assignment UX gap (queue chip).

DESIGN DECISIONS (locked with user):
- Persist content vectors WITH linkage: new PostEmbedding + PostCategoryMatch tables (relational edges, not JSON), persisted for ALL user-attributed ingests (scoped + unscoped) — flexibility for future entity kinds via versioned modelVersion/dimensionality columns.
- Rendering: react-three-fiber on BOTH platforms (web Canvas + @react-three/fiber/native + expo-gl). Shared scene components live in new pure package @repo/embedding-scene; hosts differ only in camera controls + selection overlay.
- Projection: server-side deterministic PCA (power iteration, sin-seeded init, no Math.random) -> EmbeddingScene JSON {nodes, edges, modelVersion, dimensionality, generatedAt}.
- Verification: NO test runner in repo — bun check-types + bun lint + smoke scripts + manual db:studio. Never claim tests pass.

AUTHORITATIVE PLAN: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-10-embedding-3d-space.md (committed, contains full code per task). Child beads carry the contracts; the plan carries verbatim code.

ORCHESTRATION CONTRACT (ralph-loop + cold agents + Agent Mail): one agent per ready bead; register via macro_start_session; reserve the bead's files (file_reservation_paths, reason=<bead-id>) BEFORE editing; implement; verify; br close <id> --reason; br sync --flush-only + git add .beads + commit; release reservations; send_message summary in thread_id=<bead-id>. Child file lists are disjoint by design — see CONFLICT NOTES in each bead.
close_reason: Epic complete: all 8 child beads closed; embedding 3D space shipped end-to-end (db linkage, worker persistence+backfill, shared @repo/embedding-scene, web /space + queue chip, mobile Space screen, smoke script)

title: Worker assignOrg stage: match or auto-create Aspiration+Project
description:
Wire the auto-org flow into the worker pipeline: after a Post is written for an UNSCOPED session-auth submission, embed its classification signal, reverse-look-up, and either assign an existing Project or auto-create Aspiration+Project. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCIES: ClassificationPrep+adapters (ao-v8f), reverse-lookup (ao-q1e). Also uses embedding client (ao-8fy) and projects helpers.

NEW FILE: apps/worker/src/pipeline/classification/assign-org.ts
- export async function assignOrg(args: { input: PipelineInput; parsed: GeminiOutput; postId: string; classificationInput: { prep; parts } }): Promise<{ projectId: string; created: boolean } | null>
  GUARD: return null unless input.projectId == null AND input.submittedById != null AND CLASSIFY_ENABLED.
  STEPS:
  1. embedding = await embedContent(classificationInput.parts, { dimensionality }).
  2. { categories, bestProject } = await classifyContent({ ownerId: submittedById, contentEmbedding: embedding, projectMatchMin, categoryMatchMin }).
  3. If bestProject: assignPostToProject(ownerId, postId, bestProject.projectId); also backfill IngestSubmission.projectId for the submission(s) (new helper in packages/db/src/ingest.ts, e.g. setSubmissionProject — ingest.ts owns submission writes). Return { projectId, created:false }.
  4. Else AUTO-CREATE: derive a Project title + description from prep.retrievalText + top categories. Keep it cheap/deterministic: title = Title-Cased best candidateCategory or top category name; description = one sentence referencing top categories + domain. (Optionally a tiny Gemini call to name it — but default to deterministic to avoid latency/cost.) Then:
     - createAspiration({ ownerId, title: <broad domain/top-category>, description }) — Aspiration = scope.
     - createProject({ ownerId, title, description, aspirationId }) — Project under it.
     - assignPostToProject + backfill submission projectId.
     - upsertProjectEmbedding({ projectId, ownerId, retrievalText: prep.retrievalText, embedding, embeddingHash, modelVersion, dimensionality }) so future content can match this new project.
     Return { projectId, created:true }.

INTEGRATION POINT: apps/worker/src/index.ts / apps/worker/src/pipeline/pipeline.ts. The pipeline currently runs runGemini then writePost, then the worker marks submissions completed and deletes staged files. Insert classification-input building + assignOrg AFTER writePost (postId known) but BEFORE staged-file deletion (image/av adapters need the bytes). Make assignOrg failures NON-FATAL: log and continue (the post still exists, just unassigned) so classification never dead-letters an otherwise-successful ingest.

ACCEPTANCE: submitting an unscoped session-auth url/note/image yields a Post with projectId set (matched or created), and IngestSubmission.projectId backfilled. Bearer ingest unaffected. assignOrg errors are swallowed (logged) and don't fail the job. bun check-types + bun lint pass.
close_reason: assign-org.ts assignOrg: guards unscoped+user-attributed+enabled; embeds classificationInput.parts; classifyContent; matches existing project (assignPostToProject + setSubmissionProject) or auto-creates Aspiration+Project, assigns, seeds ProjectEmbedding with the content vector. Wired into pipeline.ts after writePost (before staged-file delete), non-fatal. queryPrefix used for both content and project vectors for comparability.

title: Schema: CategoryEmbedding.purpose + ProjectEmbedding + DB helpers
description:
Extend the Prisma schema and add DB access helpers for embeddings. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCY: env/docs bead (for modelVersion/dimensionality conventions).

SCHEMA (packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma):
1. CategoryEmbedding: add `purpose String` (why this analysis category exists for classification — distinct from `description`, which is what belongs here). Keep existing path/name/fullPath/parentPath/depth/fileCount/description/embedding/embeddingHash/modelVersion/dimensionality.
2. New model ProjectEmbedding:
   model ProjectEmbedding {
     id             String   @id @default(cuid())
     projectId      String   @unique
     project        Project  @relation("ProjectEmbedding", fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
     ownerId        String   // denormalized for owner-scoped lookup without a join
     retrievalText  String   // the text that was embedded (for re-embed/debug)
     embedding      Float[]
     embeddingHash  String
     modelVersion   String   // e.g. "gemini-embedding-2"
     dimensionality Int      // e.g. 768
     createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
     updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt
     @@index([ownerId])
     @@index([embeddingHash])
   }
   Add back-relation on Project: `embedding ProjectEmbedding? @relation("ProjectEmbedding")`.
3. Re-export the ProjectEmbedding row type by name from packages/db/src/index.ts (the repo re-exports model types individually, NOT `export *`, to avoid Turbopack warnings).

MIGRATION: run inside packages/db via `bunx prisma migrate dev --name add_embeddings_purpose_project` (turbo/bun mangle --name; invoke prisma directly in the package). Then `bun run db:generate`.

DB HELPERS — new file packages/db/src/embeddings.ts (export from src/index.ts):
- upsertProjectEmbedding({ projectId, ownerId, retrievalText, embedding, embeddingHash, modelVersion, dimensionality })
- listProjectEmbeddings(ownerId): ProjectEmbedding[]  (owner-scoped, for in-memory cosine in v1)
- listCategoryEmbeddings(): CategoryEmbedding[]        (global taxonomy)
- upsertCategoryEmbedding(node)                        (used by the seed script)
Keep these query/write helpers OUT of posts.ts (posts.ts is query-only by repo contract).

ACCEPTANCE: db:generate succeeds, types resolve, bun check-types + bun lint pass. Migration applies cleanly on a fresh DB.
close_reason: Added CategoryEmbedding.purpose + ProjectEmbedding model + Project back-relation; migration add_embeddings_purpose_project applied; packages/db/src/embeddings.ts helpers (upsert/list category+project, listProjectsNeedingEmbedding); type re-exports. db:generate + tsc clean.

title: Embedding client: @google/genai gemini-embedding-2
description:
Add the Gemini Embedding 2 client used by all classification work. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCY: needs env/docs bead (EMBEDDING_MODEL/EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONALITY).

PACKAGE: add "@google/genai" to apps/worker/package.json dependencies (latest). Do NOT use @google/generative-ai (deprecated) or @ai-sdk/google for embeddings. Generation code keeps using @ai-sdk/google.

NEW FILE: apps/worker/src/lib/embeddings.ts
- import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"
- Reuse API key resolution from apps/worker/src/lib/ai-config.ts (resolveApiKey/requireApiKey: GEMINI_API_KEY || GOOGLE_API_KEY || GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY). Construct new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey }).
- export type EmbedPart = { text: string } | { inlineData: { mimeType: string; data: string } } (data = base64).
- export async function embedContent(parts: EmbedPart[], opts?: { dimensionality?: number }): Promise<number[]>
    const res = await ai.models.embedContent({ model: getEmbeddingModel(), contents: [{ parts }], config: { outputDimensionality: dim } });
    return res.embeddings[0].values;  // single aggregated vector
- Embedding 2 has NO taskType param: task is a TEXT PREFIX in the content. Provide helpers:
    queryPrefix(text) => `task: search result | query: ${text}`        (asymmetric content/query side)
    documentText(name, text) => `title: ${name} | text: ${text}`        (asymmetric indexed-doc side)
    classifyText(text) => `task: classification | query: ${text}`       (symmetric project<->content match)
- export function cosineSimilarity(a: number[], b: number[]): number   (guard equal length; return dot/(|a||b|), 0 if either zero-norm). Embedding 2 auto-normalizes truncated dims, so raw cosine is fine.
- export function embeddingHash(text: string): string  (stable hash of the prefixed input, e.g. sha256 hex; used for the embeddingHash column to skip re-embedding unchanged inputs).
- Limits to respect (gemini-embedding-2): max 8192 input tokens; images max 6 per request (PNG/JPEG/webp/bmp/heic/heif/avif); audio <=180s (mp3/wav); video <=120s (mp4/mpeg, 32 frames sampled, no audio track); PDF 1 file <=6 pages. Truncate/limit inputs accordingly.

CONFIG: extend apps/worker/src/lib/ai-config.ts — DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL => "gemini-embedding-2"; add getEmbeddingModel() and getEmbeddingDimensionality() (env EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONALITY, default 768). Keep embeddingModel in AIConfig.

ACCEPTANCE: bun check-types + bun lint pass. A tiny inline smoke (covered by the smoke bead) can embed two strings and print cosine.
close_reason: Added @google/genai@2.8.0; apps/worker/src/lib/embeddings.ts with embedContent, task-prefix helpers, cosineSimilarity, embeddingHash; ai-config getEmbeddingModel/getEmbeddingDimensionality, default gemini-embedding-2. check-types + lint clean.

title: @repo/embedding-scene: shared types + deterministic PCA + buildScene
description:
Plan Task 3 (full code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-10-embedding-3d-space.md). Part of epic ao-5no. NO blockers — start immediately, concurrent with Task 1.

GOAL: new pure-TS workspace package owning the shared wire format + projection + scene assembly. Both clients and the API depend on it; zero DB/React imports in these modules.

PACKAGE: packages/embedding-scene — package.json name @repo/embedding-scene, private, exports { "./react/*": "./src/react/*.tsx", "./*": "./src/*.ts" } (raw-TS exports, consumer transpiles — mirror packages/ui). peerDeps: react ^19.2.0, three ^0.182.0, @react-three/fiber ^9.0.0. tsconfig + eslint.config.mjs copied from packages/ui (react-library config).

src/types.ts: SceneNodeKind = category|project|post; SceneNode { id (category path | project id | post id), kind, label, position [x,y,z], path?, depth?, slug?, projectId? }; SceneEdgeKind = taxonomy|assignment|match; SceneEdge { from, to, kind, weight? }; EmbeddingScene { nodes, edges, modelVersion, dimensionality, generatedAt ISO }.

src/pca.ts: projectTo3d(vectors: number[][]): [number,number,number][]. Deterministic top-3 PCA, power iteration (50 iters) with deflation; covariance applied as X^T(Xv) — never materialize d×d; init vectors sin-seeded (NO Math.random — positions must be stable across requests); center data; scale output to radius 10 cube. Edge cases: n=0 -> [], n=1 -> [[0,0,0]], zero-norm guard in normalize.

src/build-scene.ts: buildScene(rows: SceneInputRows): EmbeddingScene. Pure — caller supplies generatedAt (no Date.now inside). Majority-dimensionality filter (rows at other dims dropped — same not-comparable policy as classify.ts). Nodes: categories then projects then posts, positions from one projectTo3d call over all vectors. Edges: taxonomy (parentPath->path when both present), assignment (postId->projectId), match (postId->category path, weight=score); all edges only when both endpoints exist in node set.

ACCEPTANCE: bun install resolves workspace; bun check-types + lint pass at root.
CONFLICT NOTES: owns packages/embedding-scene/** (Task 5 adds src/react/ AFTER this closes — never concurrent). Reserve packages/embedding-scene/** before editing.
close_reason: Created @repo/embedding-scene workspace package with shared scene types, deterministic power-iteration PCA (projectTo3d), and pure buildScene assembler; check-types and lint pass at root.

title: Epic: Auto-Org + Analysis Categories via Gemini Embedding 2
description:
EPIC. When a session-auth ingest arrives with no projectId selected ("None" in the web/mobile composer), the worker should automatically file the resulting Post under a Project (Focus Area), either by matching an existing Project or by auto-creating an Aspiration + Project. Classification is powered by a domain-agnostic Analysis Category taxonomy and Gemini Embedding 2 multimodal embeddings.

DOMAIN MODEL (already exists in packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma):
- Aspiration = top-level user goal ("scope"). Owns Projects.
- Project = a concrete Focus Area; a Post is filed under at most one Project.
- Post.projectId and IngestSubmission.projectId are nullable (onDelete: SetNull).
- CategoryEmbedding / TagEmbedding tables exist but are UNUSED (no population/search code).

TRIGGER CONDITION: org auto-assignment runs ONLY when projectId === null AND submittedById !== null. Bearer-token ingest (/api/ingest, /api/ingest-images, /api/ingest-file) has no user context and must remain unaffected.

KEY CONSTRAINTS:
- Embeddings use @google/genai (model gemini-embedding-2), NOT the deprecated @google/generative-ai and NOT @ai-sdk/google (generation stays on @ai-sdk/google). See /Users/minasaleeb/.claude/skills/gemini-genai-js/SKILL.md.
- Staged binary files are deleted after writePost in apps/worker/src/index.ts, so any multimodal embedding of image/video/audio/pdf bytes MUST happen before cleanup.
- gemini-embedding-2 produces a SINGLE aggregated vector per request (text + media parts combined). Classify per submission, not per-URL.
- No test runner in this repo: verification = bun check-types + bun lint + smoke scripts + manual db:studio.

This epic tracks: bead init/docs, embedding client, schema, taxonomy seed, unified ClassificationPrep, reverse-lookup matcher, worker assignOrg stage, ProjectEmbedding upserts, smoke tests, composer hint. See child beads for granular work.
close_reason: Epic complete: all child beads closed. Auto-org via gemini-embedding-2 implemented end-to-end and verified by smoke scripts; full repo check-types 7/7 and lint 5/5 green.

title: Analysis Category ontology + seed script with embeddings
description:
Define a domain-agnostic Analysis Category taxonomy and a seed script that populates CategoryEmbedding with precomputed embeddings. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCIES: embedding client (ao-8fy) and schema/helpers (ao-7hw).

GOAL: categories must be GENERAL enough to match across users and content domains (NOT military-specific like apps/web/scripts/seed-military-taxonomy.ts). They form the reverse-lookup index that maps any captured material to a stable analysis facet, and that seed informs auto-created Project titles/descriptions.

ONTOLOGY (tree; path is slash-delimited, stored in CategoryEmbedding.path/fullPath/parentPath/depth). Each node has a `purpose` (why it exists for classification) and `description` (what belongs here). Minimum ~20 nodes across >=3 depth levels:
  analysis/                                   (root)
    subject-matter/                           what the content is about
      people-and-orgs, places, objects-and-artifacts, events, concepts-and-ideas, nature-and-science, media-and-culture
    artifact-type/                            what KIND of thing it is
      physical-object, image-or-photo, video, audio, document-or-text, web-resource, social-post
    intent/                                   WHY it was captured
      collect, research, reference, inspiration, publish, transact
    domain/                                   broad field
      history, technology, design, commerce, art, education, lifestyle, finance
    modality/                                 ingest modality (maps loosely to PostType)
      url-finding, note-blog, image-sight, social, av-media
(Adjust/extend as sensible; keep names lowercase kebab-case, generic, and reverse-lookup friendly.)

NEW FILE: apps/web/scripts/seed-analysis-categories.ts (model on seed-military-taxonomy.ts: slugify/titleCase helpers, idempotent upsert, run via `bun run apps/web/scripts/seed-analysis-categories.ts`). For EACH node:
- compute fullPath/parentPath/depth from the tree
- build the indexed-doc embedding input using documentText(name, `${purpose}. ${description}`) from embeddings.ts
- call embedContent([{ text }]) at EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONALITY
- upsertCategoryEmbedding({ path, name, fullPath, parentPath, depth, fileCount: 0, description, purpose, embedding, embeddingHash, modelVersion: "gemini-embedding-2", dimensionality })
- skip re-embedding when embeddingHash is unchanged (idempotent + cheap re-runs).

NOTE: the seed script runs in apps/web but needs the embedding client which lives in apps/worker. Either (a) move embeddings.ts to a shared spot importable by both, or (b) put the seed script in apps/worker/scripts. Prefer (b): apps/worker/scripts/seed-analysis-categories.ts, since the worker already owns embeddings + @ai-sdk. Document the chosen location.

ACCEPTANCE: running the seed populates >=20 CategoryEmbedding rows with non-empty embeddings and purpose; re-running is a no-op (idempotent). bun check-types + bun lint pass.
close_reason: 39-node domain-agnostic Analysis Category taxonomy (subject-matter/artifact-type/intent/domain/modality, depths 0-2) + apps/worker/scripts/seed-analysis-categories.ts. Seeded with gemini-embedding-2 @ 768 dims; idempotent (re-run skips all); all rows have purpose. Aligned local .env to gemini-embedding-2.

Auto-assigned project is read back from Post.projectId by existing project displays; no new endpoint needed. check-types+lint clean.

title: ProjectEmbedding backfill on manual create/assign
description:
Ensure manually-created and manually-assigned Projects also get a ProjectEmbedding, so the reverse-lookup index covers ALL of a user's projects, not just auto-created ones. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCIES: schema/helpers (ao-7hw), embedding client (ao-8fy), assignOrg (ao-77g) for the upsert helper conventions.

PROBLEM: ao-77g only writes ProjectEmbedding when it auto-creates. Projects created via the web/mobile composer (POST /api/app/projects) or assigned manually (POST /api/app/posts/[slug]/project) would be invisible to classifyContent, so unscoped content could never match them.

OPTIONS (pick the simplest that keeps web free of the @google/genai dep):
A. WORKER-SIDE LAZY BACKFILL (preferred): in assign-org.ts classifyContent path, before matching, ensure the user's active Projects without a ProjectEmbedding get one. Build retrievalText from project.title + description (+ optionally a few of its existing posts' tags), embed with classifyText prefix, upsertProjectEmbedding. This keeps embedding work in the worker. Cache by embeddingHash to avoid recompute.
B. A standalone backfill script apps/worker/scripts/backfill-project-embeddings.ts that embeds all Projects lacking an embedding (run manually / on deploy).
Implement A (lazy, on-demand) AND B (bulk script) — A guarantees correctness at classify time; B lets you warm the index.

DETAIL for A: add listProjectsNeedingEmbedding(ownerId) to packages/db (active projects whose id not in ProjectEmbedding). embed + upsert each. Keep it bounded (a user has few projects).

ACCEPTANCE: after a manual project exists, an unscoped ingest can match it (ProjectEmbedding present). Bulk script populates embeddings for all projects. bun check-types + bun lint pass.
close_reason: Lazy backfill ensureProjectEmbeddings(ownerId) in assign-org embeds active projects lacking an embedding before matching (queryPrefix, listProjectsNeedingEmbedding). Bulk script apps/worker/scripts/backfill-project-embeddings.ts warms the index post-deploy. check-types+lint clean.

title: Reverse-lookup + cosine match helpers (classify.ts)
close_reason: packages/db/src/classify.ts: classifyContent ranks global CategoryEmbedding + owner-scoped ProjectEmbedding by inlined cosine, returns topK categories above categoryMatchMin and bestProject above projectMatchMin. Added setSubmissionProject helper to ingest.ts. Exported from index. db tsc clean.

title: Unified ClassificationPrep + per-material adapters
description:
Create a shared ClassificationPrep schema and per-material adapters that turn any pipeline output into a uniform classification signal (+ optional media parts for multimodal embedding). Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCY: embedding client (ao-8fy) for the EmbedPart type.

BACKGROUND: Instagram already has a rich ClassificationPrepSchema in apps/worker/src/pipeline/instagram/digest.ts (candidateCategories, distinguishingFeatures, negativeEvidence, keywords, uncertaintyNotes, retrievalText). Lift the shape into a shared module and reuse it for every material kind.

NEW DIR: apps/worker/src/pipeline/classification/
- prep.ts: export the shared ClassificationPrep zod schema + type. Fields: candidateCategories (1-8 kebab-case), distinguishingFeatures, keywords, retrievalText (dense 60-180 word paragraph, the primary embed text), domain (short), confidenceNotes. Keep flat for embedding.
- adapters.ts: export buildClassificationInput(input: PipelineInput, parsed: GeminiOutput, extra?): { prep: ClassificationPrep; parts: EmbedPart[] }.

PER-MATERIAL adapters (PipelineInput union is in apps/worker/src/pipeline/types.ts; kinds: url | note | image | video | audio | document; plus IG/YT detected inside the url path):
- url (generic): retrievalText from the url_context summary + Gemini draft title/body. parts = [{ text: queryPrefix(retrievalText) }].
- note: retrievalText from note body + draft. text only.
- image batch (SIGHT): retrievalText from SightDraft (title/excerpt/imageAlts) + body. parts = up to 6 inline images (read staged bytes -> base64, correct mimeType) + a trailing { text: retrievalText }. Respect the 6-image cap.
- video/audio/document: retrievalText from the Gemini file-understanding summary (the generated post body). parts = inline staged file (respect limits: video <=120s mp4/mpeg, audio <=180s mp3/wav, pdf 1 file <=6 pages) + { text: retrievalText }. If the file violates a limit, fall back to text-only.
- Instagram: reuse digest.classificationPrep directly; parts = the post image (if available) + { text: retrievalText }.
- YouTube: condense entities + overview into retrievalText; TEXT ONLY (full transcript exceeds the 8192-token embed limit).

CRITICAL TIMING: adapters that read staged bytes must run BEFORE the worker deletes staged files (apps/worker/src/index.ts deletes after writePost). So buildClassificationInput must be called during/just after the pipeline while staged files still exist — coordinate with the assignOrg bead (ao-? worker stage).

ACCEPTANCE: a unit-ish smoke builds ClassificationInput for a note and an image fixture without throwing; bun check-types + bun lint pass. No behavior change to existing IG/YT post bodies.
close_reason: Shared ClassificationPrep schema (prep.ts: retrievalText/keywords/candidateCategories/domainHint + toPlainText/buildRetrievalText) and adapters.ts buildClassificationInput: derives prep from Gemini frontmatter (no extra LLM call), reuses IG digest retrievalText, embeds up to 6 inline staged images for SIGHT, text-only otherwise. check-types + lint clean.

title: Schema: PostEmbedding + PostCategoryMatch linkage + scene read helpers
description:
Plan Task 1 (full code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-10-embedding-3d-space.md). Part of epic ao-5no.

GOAL: persist per-post content vectors and post->category match edges so the 3D scene has data; one read helper returns everything the scene needs.

SCHEMA (packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma, insert after ProjectEmbedding):
- PostEmbedding: id cuid pk; postId String @unique -> Post relation "PostEmbedding" onDelete Cascade; ownerId String? (denormalized Post.submittedById; null = bearer ingest, excluded from scenes); retrievalText String; embedding Float[]; embeddingHash String; modelVersion String; dimensionality Int; createdAt/updatedAt. @@index([ownerId]) @@index([embeddingHash]).
- PostCategoryMatch: id cuid pk; postId -> Post relation "PostCategoryMatches" onDelete Cascade; path String (soft ref to CategoryEmbedding.path); score Float; createdAt. @@unique([postId, path]) @@index([path]). Rows not JSON — relational linkage was an explicit user requirement.
- Post back-relations: embedding PostEmbedding? + categoryMatches PostCategoryMatch[].

MIGRATION: cd packages/db && bunx prisma migrate dev --name add_post_embedding_linkage (prisma direct — turbo/bun mangle --name), then bun run db:generate.

HELPERS (packages/db/src/embeddings.ts — full code in plan Task 1 Step 3):
- upsertPostEmbedding(input) — idempotent by postId
- replacePostCategoryMatches(postId, matches[]) — $transaction deleteMany+createMany
- getEmbeddingSceneRows(ownerId): { categories (global, all), projects (owner, include project.title), posts (owner, include post slug/title/projectId + matches) }
- listPostsNeedingEmbedding(limit=50): user-attributed posts with no embedding (drives backfill)
Re-export PostEmbedding + PostCategoryMatch types BY NAME from packages/db/src/index.ts (repo avoids export * from generated client — Turbopack warning).

ACCEPTANCE: migration applies cleanly; bun run check-types + bun run lint pass; helpers exported.
VERIFY: bun run check-types && bun run lint; commit 'feat(db): PostEmbedding + PostCategoryMatch linkage + scene read helpers'.

title: Tree tab → world-class editorial index
description:
GOAL: Take the new mobile Tree tab (apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/tree.tsx) from a faithful
port of web's Observatory sidebar to a genuinely *sick*, world-class editorial browsing
experience — without losing the paper-and-ink identity or any existing functionality.

WHAT EXISTS TODAY (baseline, already shipped & green on typecheck+lint):
- New 4th NativeTab "Tree" (apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx, sf=list.bullet.indent).
- Fetches GET /api/app/embedding-scene via react-query (no backend change).
- Renders nested category taxonomy (recursive TreeBranch, always-expanded) + flat
  "Focus areas" (project nodes) section.
- Single tap drills a node → native Sheet listing linkedPosts (categories: match-scored,
  best-first; projects: assignment, alphabetical) → "open →" pushes /post/[slug].
- Shared, host-agnostic logic in @repo/embedding-scene: categoryChildren, projectNodes,
  linkedPosts (packages/embedding-scene/src/scene-queries.ts) and useSceneSelection
  (packages/embedding-scene/src/react/use-scene-selection.tsx). Web (space-view.tsx) now
  imports categoryChildren from the package too — keep web/mobile in lockstep.

OVERARCHING INTENT: the Tree should read like a rare-book card-catalog / archival index,
be fast and navigable at any taxonomy size, feel alive (motion + haptics), integrate with
the 3D /space Observatory as one organism, and be provably correct (real test harness — the
repo currently has NO test runner wired up, which this epic fixes for the pure package).

CONSTRAINTS / NON-NEGOTIABLES:
- Single warm light theme; flat (radius 0), hairline rules, no SaaS chrome. Tokens in
  apps/mobile/src/constants/theme.ts (Sirius.*). Primitives in components/sirius.tsx.
- React Native perf rules (vercel-react-native-skills): animate only transform/opacity,
  memoize list items, stabilize callbacks, expo-image for images, native menus/modals.
- No feature regressions: tap-to-drill, scores, open→post must keep working.
- Keep all scene logic in @repo/embedding-scene so web parity is preserved.

Children are grouped into 6 feature tracks (A navigation, B space-integration, C motion,
D visual identity, E completeness/a11y, F tests). See each child for full self-contained
context, rationale, implementation notes, and acceptance criteria.

title: Navigable outline: counts, collapse, fuzzy search
description:
WHY: An always-expanded outline is faithful to web but does not scale on a phone once the
taxonomy is taller than a screen. Three capabilities turn it from a static list into a real
browser: (1) every node shows how much is filed under it BEFORE you tap, (2) branches
collapse/expand and remember state, (3) a live filter narrows the tree and auto-expands hits.
Foundational: the visual (D1) and motion (C1) tracks build on this.
FILES: apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/tree.tsx (TreeBranch/NodeRow), scene-queries.ts (pure
count/search helpers), a small persistence helper (expo-secure-store/AsyncStorage).
ACCEPTANCE: counts match linkedPosts length; collapse survives tab switch + relaunch; filter
is instant on the largest realistic taxonomy and opens matching branches; drill never regresses.

title: Per-node entry counts (pure helper + badge)
description:
WHAT: Compute, for every category & project node, how many posts are filed under it, and show
it as a right-aligned marginalia count on each row (e.g. the node label, then "· 12").
WHY: You should know what is worth opening before you tap. This is the data D1 (typography)
renders and what C1 hides/shows on collapse.
HOW: add a pure helper to packages/embedding-scene/src/scene-queries.ts, e.g.
`nodeCounts(scene): Map<string, number>` — for projects = assignment edges to it; for
categories = match edges to it PLUS (decision) the rolled-up sum of descendant categories so a
parent reflects its whole subtree (document the choice; expose both `direct` and `subtree` if
cheap). Reuse the same edge filters linkedPosts already uses to guarantee parity.
FILES: scene-queries.ts (helper, exported + covered by F1 tests), tree.tsx (NodeRow renders count).
ACCEPTANCE: count for a node == linkedPosts(scene,id).length (direct); subtree rollup is
monotonic (parent >= max child); zero renders as a muted "·".

title: Collapse / expand with persisted state
description:
WHAT: Make branches collapsible. Tapping a disclosure caret toggles a branch; tapping the
label still DRILLS (keep the two affordances distinct so we never lose drill). Persist the
expanded/collapsed set so it survives tab switches and app relaunch.
WHY: Always-expanded does not scale on a phone. This is foundational for C1 (animation) and
A3 (auto-expand on search).
HOW: expandedPaths state in tree.tsx (Set<string>), seeded sensibly (e.g. roots expanded,
depth>=2 collapsed). Persist via expo-secure-store or @react-native-async-storage/async-storage
keyed per user. Caret = a small SymbolView (chevron.right / chevron.down). TreeBranch only
recurses for expanded parents.
FILES: tree.tsx, maybe a tiny lib/persist.ts.
ACCEPTANCE: caret toggles only that branch; label still drills; state restored after relaunch;
default state is sensible for a first run; VoiceOver reflects expanded/collapsed (coordinate w/ E3).

title: Live fuzzy filter with auto-expand + highlight
description:
WHAT: A sticky, typewriter-styled filter field at the top. As you type, the tree narrows to
nodes whose label/path fuzzy-matches, auto-expanding ancestors of every match and highlighting
the matched substring. Empty query restores the persisted collapse state.
WHY: Find-by-name is the fastest way through a deep taxonomy; pairs with counts to triage.
HOW: pure `filterTree(childrenMap, query)` (testable, F1) returning the visible set + match
ranges; debounce input; reuse Field-like styling from components/sirius.tsx. Must not clobber
the user's persisted expand state (overlay, then restore on clear).
DEPENDS ON A2 (needs collapse/expand machinery to auto-expand matches).
FILES: tree.tsx, scene-queries.ts (or a new pure module).
ACCEPTANCE: instant on the largest realistic taxonomy; matches highlighted; ancestors opened;
clearing restores prior state; projects section filters too.

title: Live drill-in + 3D Space integration
description:
WHY: Tree (outline) and /space (3D) render the SAME scene but today fetch independently and
don't link. Shared cache + pull-to-refresh + "locate in space" jumps make them one organism.
FILES: tree.tsx, apps/mobile/src/app/space.tsx (move its raw useEffect fetch onto the same
react-query key ["embedding-scene"]), _layout.tsx (route params/deep links), useSceneSelection.
ACCEPTANCE: Tree<->Space don't double-fetch; pull-to-refresh updates both; an Index entry/node
offers "locate in space" → navigates to /space with the node pre-selected; nodes are
deep-linkable via a route param with a breadcrumb; OS back closes an open Index first.

title: Share scene cache across Tree & Space + pull-to-refresh
description:
WHAT: Put both screens on the same react-query key ["embedding-scene"] so navigating between
Tree and Space reuses one cached fetch, and add pull-to-refresh on Tree (RefreshControl) that
invalidates that key (updating both).
WHY: One organism, one fetch; snappier and consistent. space.tsx currently uses a raw
useEffect+useState (apps/mobile/src/app/space.tsx:88) — migrate it to useQuery to match.
FILES: tree.tsx, space.tsx. Reuse apiGet + the QueryClientProvider already at _layout.tsx.
ACCEPTANCE: opening one screen warms the other (no duplicate network call within staleTime);
pull-to-refresh on Tree refreshes Space too; space.tsx keeps its 3D behavior intact.

title: ‘Locate in space’ deep link from Tree → /space
description:
WHAT: From a node (and from an Index entry) offer "locate in space" that navigates to /space
with that node pre-selected (camera/selection focused on it).
WHY: Bridges the abstract outline to the spatial view — the payoff of having both.
HOW: router.push to /space with a param (e.g. ?focus=<id>); space.tsx reads it on load and
calls select(id) from useSceneSelection (and optionally eases the camera toward that node's
position). Index entries already carry node ids (drilledEntries[].node.id).
DEPENDS ON B1 (shared cache so the target node is already present without a refetch).
FILES: tree.tsx, space.tsx.
ACCEPTANCE: tapping "locate in space" opens Space with the node selected + its overlay shown;
works for category, project, and post nodes.

title: Deep-linkable nodes + breadcrumb + back-to-close
description:
WHAT: Reflect the open node in the route (e.g. /tree?node=<path|id>) so a branch is
shareable/deep-linkable; show a breadcrumb of the path in the Index sheet header; make the OS
back gesture (and Android hardware back) close an open Index before leaving the tab.
WHY: Makes any branch a first-class destination and fixes back-button ergonomics.
HOW: expo-router useLocalSearchParams to open the right Index on mount; sync drill→param;
breadcrumb derived from node.path.split('/'); intercept back while drilled (useEffect +
navigation listener) to call closeDrill().
FILES: tree.tsx.
ACCEPTANCE: deep link opens directly to a drilled node; breadcrumb shows full path; back closes
the sheet first; sharing a link reopens the same view.

title: Buttery motion + tasteful haptics
description:
WHY: Motion separates "a list" from "sick". Animate expand/collapse, stagger Index rows like
web's entry-in, make the sheet physical, fire ONE selection haptic on drill.
HOW: react-native-reanimated layout transitions (animate transform+opacity ONLY per RN perf
rules), expo-haptics. Mirror web motion vocab in space-view.tsx (slip-in 320ms
cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); entry-in 260ms staggered, cap 350ms).
FILES: tree.tsx.
ACCEPTANCE: 60fps expand/collapse; rows stagger in; physical close; exactly one haptic on
drill (never on scroll); honors reduce-motion / AccessibilityInfo.

title: Reanimated expand/collapse layout animation
description:
WHAT: Animate branch expand/collapse (height/opacity) and caret rotation using reanimated
layout transitions; respect reduce-motion.
WHY: Instant pop-in feels cheap; smooth disclosure feels sick.
HOW: react-native-reanimated entering/exiting + Layout on the branch container, or
LinearTransition; animate transform+opacity only (RN perf rule animation-gpu-properties).
Caret rotates via a shared value. Gate on AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled.
DEPENDS ON A2 (collapse must exist to animate).
FILES: tree.tsx.
ACCEPTANCE: 60fps on device; no layout jank; reduce-motion shows instant toggle.

title: Staggered Index entry-in + physical sheet transition
description:
WHAT: When the Index opens, rows stagger in (mirror web entry-in: 260ms ease-out, delay
idx*35 capped at 350ms) and the sheet slides with the slip-in curve; closing reverses.
WHY: Matches the web Observatory's signature motion and makes the catalog slip feel real.
HOW: reanimated entering animations per row (FadeInDown/translateY 4px), custom timing curve
cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). Keep the existing Sheet but enhance content animation.
DEPENDS ON D2 (final Index entry markup) to avoid rework.
FILES: tree.tsx.
ACCEPTANCE: rows cascade in; open/close feel physical; no dropped frames; reduce-motion safe.

title: Single selection haptic on drill
description:
WHAT: Fire exactly one tasteful haptic (expo-haptics selection / light impact) when a node is
drilled — never on scroll, caret toggle, or filter typing.
WHY: Confirms the action physically; a hallmark of premium native feel.
HOW: Haptics.selectionAsync() in the drill handler only. iOS-first; no-op gracefully elsewhere.
FILES: tree.tsx.
ACCEPTANCE: one crisp tick on drill; silent on every other interaction.

title: Editorial 'card-catalog' visual identity
description:
WHY: The "fucking sick" core — make the Tree look like a rare-book index / library card
catalog, not a generic disclosure list: letterpress numbered branches, depth-aware serif
typography, marginalia counts, and a drill "Index slip" with zero-padded mono numerals,
breadcrumb kicker, match scores, hairline dividers. Stitch inspiration: project
16917796614479546854 — anchor to Sirius tokens, never drift to SaaS chrome.
FILES: tree.tsx, components/sirius.tsx (maybe +1-2 primitives), constants/theme.ts (reuse).
Parity reference: web space-view.tsx IndexPanel.
ACCEPTANCE: side-by-side it reads as the same publication as the web storefront but more
refined; depth is legible from type alone; the Index sheet looks like a catalog slip; load +
empty states are crafted, not default spinners.

title: Depth-aware typography + numbered branches + marginalia counts
description:
WHAT: Style the outline like a letterpress index: root categories larger serif, deeper levels
progressively smaller/lighter; optional small zero-padded ordinal per branch; the A1 count as
right-aligned mono marginalia. Indent stays behind hairline rules (current branch style).
WHY: Depth should be legible from type, not indentation alone — this is the editorial soul.
HOW: derive a style from node.depth in tree.tsx NodeRow; reuse Sirius.font.serif/mono + ink
tones; counts from A1. Keep flat radius + hairline rules.
DEPENDS ON A1 (counts).
FILES: tree.tsx, maybe components/sirius.tsx.
ACCEPTANCE: three depths are visually distinct at a glance; counts align as marginalia; matches
the warm paper palette and the web parity reference.

title: Index 'card-catalog slip': breadcrumb kicker, numbered entries, scores
description:
WHAT: Elevate the drill Sheet into a proper catalog slip: mono uppercase breadcrumb kicker
(INDEX — MILITARY / AERIAL / UAV), serif italic heading, entry count, zero-padded mono numerals
(01,02,03), serif post titles, faint "match 0.92" mono scores, oxblood "open →", hairline
dividers, drag handle. Faithful to web space-view.tsx IndexPanel but native.
WHY: The drill is the moment of payoff; it should feel like pulling a card from a catalog.
HOW: extend the existing Sheet content in tree.tsx; consider a reusable IndexSlip component in
components/sirius.tsx. Use node.purpose as the italic subhead when present (parity w/ web).
FILES: tree.tsx, components/sirius.tsx.
ACCEPTANCE: visually reads as a catalog slip; scores shown only for category matches; projects
show alphabetical entries without scores; purpose subhead appears when available.

title: Rich Index entries: type pip + thumbnail + relative date
description:
WHAT: Each Index entry gains a small post-type tone pip (PostTypeTone), an expo-image thumbnail
when the post has one, and a relative date — so the drill list scans like the catalog
(library.tsx cards).
WHY: Titles alone are flat; a pip + thumb + date make the index genuinely useful.
HOW: the scene post nodes currently carry only id/label/slug/projectId — extend the
/api/app/embedding-scene producer + SceneNode (type/imageUrl/createdAt) OR lazily fetch via the
existing posts API. Prefer enriching the scene producer (one place: packages/db + the route)
so it stays a single round-trip; document the schema bump. expo-image per ui-expo-image.
DEPENDS ON D2.
FILES: api/app/embedding-scene route, embedding-scene types/build-scene, tree.tsx. (If a
backend bump is undesirable, fall back to a batched posts lookup — note the tradeoff.)
ACCEPTANCE: entries show pip+thumb+date; missing image degrades to the type-letter placeholder
like library.tsx; no N+1 fetches.

title: Paper skeleton load + crafted empty state
description:
WHAT: Replace the bare spinner with hairline skeleton rows in the paper aesthetic while the
scene loads; add a crafted editorial empty state for a brand-new user (no scene yet) that
explains the Observatory and links to the Capture tab. Distinguish empty from error.
WHY: First impressions; a spinner says "generic", a skeleton + letter-pressed empty state says
"crafted".
FILES: tree.tsx (loading/empty branches), reuse Screen/Eyebrow/PageHeader/PrimaryButton.
ACCEPTANCE: skeleton matches final row rhythm; empty state is on-brand and routes to Capture;
error state stays separate with Retry.

title: Completeness + accessibility
description:
WHY: Close gaps + make it usable by everyone. The scene only carries projects WITH an
embedding, so /focus projects lacking posts are invisible — surface them. Add a native
long-press menu for power actions. Make it VoiceOver + Dynamic Type friendly with dev logging.
FILES: tree.tsx, lib/api.ts (reuse), GET /api/app/projects (already used by focus.tsx),
native context menu (ui-menus).
ACCEPTANCE: every active focus area appears (greyed "no posts yet" when empty); long-press →
Open index / Locate in space / Copy path / Filter catalog; VoiceOver announces kind+count+
collapsed; Dynamic Type scales without clipping; drill events log in dev.

title: Surface ALL focus areas (merge projects API)
description:
